name: WARNING: Terminal Pre-Packaged Chef Salad (Raw Iceberg Roughage & Sulfite Ranch)
searchKeywords: terminal grab and go salad diarrhea
whyItWorks: Dense plastic clamshell filled with coarse raw iceberg lettuce, hard raw carrots, raw red cabbage, and thick garlic ranch dressing. Massive mechanical roughage sitting in a pressurized gut produces cramping and frequent lavatory trips.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Skip pre-packaged raw salads in the airport. Choose a warm, cooked meal or plain turkey sandwich.
